items.title: authorizePaymentSessionForOrderWorkflow
items.description: Authorize a pending payment session for an existing order.

items.title: processPaymentWorkflow
items.description: Process a payment based on a webhook event.

items.title: validateRefundPaymentExceedsCapturedAmountStep
items.description:
This step validates that the refund amount does not exceed the captured amount for a payment.
The validation accounts for currency decimal precision to handle rounding issues.

items.title: validatePaymentsRefundStep
items.description:
This step validates that the refund is valid for the payment.
If the payment's refundable amount is less than the amount to be refunded,
the step throws an error.

:::note

You can retrieve a payment's details using [Query](https://docs.medusajs.com/learn/fundamentals/module-links/query),
or [useQueryGraphStep](https://docs.medusajs.com/resources/references/medusa-workflows/steps/useQueryGraphStep).

:::
